overview.text: The Balkan Whip Snake is a fast, slender, harmless snake of the Balkans, Greece and north-eastern Italy.

identification.text: Slender with smooth scales and big eyes with round pupils; olive-grey or yellowish-brown with dark spots towards the front.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Usually under 1 m, rarely up to 130 cm.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Extreme north-eastern Italy, coastal Slovenia and Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Serbia, Albania, mainland Greece and many islands including Crete.

habitat.text: Stony places, scree, scrub, open woodland, roadsides, pasture and plantations.

behaviour.text: Active by day, mostly on the ground; fast and agile.

diet.text: Lizards, big insects such as grasshoppers, nestling birds and small mammals.

reproduction.text: Lays 4 to 10 oval eggs, about 30 by 17 mm.

recognise.text: Slim, fast snake with dark spots near the head.
